description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Squall (Fire)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Squall (Fire)
description.text: Increases [Fire Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for attacks that deal physical damage, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Squall (Fire) after using two Fire abilities (max 3), removed if the character hasn’t Zenith Mode

description.name: Renzokuken+
description.text: Five group attacks (1.20) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Squall (Fire)
description.text: Six single attacks (0.80), 0.90 if exploiting Fire weakness, capped at 19999

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
